title: Inverted BlobWorld
altText: Hyperrealistic close-up portrait graffiti mural by Mr Blob, splitting a male face into a green wood-textured side and a purple side with organic orange root patterns.
description: Painted on a free wall in Milan, this hyperrealistic close-up splits a male face into two chromatic worlds: an acid-green half and a violet half overrun by orange root-like growths branching across the skin. As the title suggests, the piece turns the bio-organic language of the artist's BlobWorld imagery inward, mapping it onto a human portrait executed freehand in spray paint.
